quarterly_data.quarter: Digital Realty press release: Digital Realty to Develop New Cable Landing Station in Los (09-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Digital Realty announced plans to develop a new cable landing station (CLS) at its LAX12 data center in Los Angeles in partnership with Assured Communications, which is supporting the design, engineering and construction. The CLS is designed to give subsea cable operators a turnkey solution for landing and powering their systems, with interconnection to terrestrial networks, cloud providers and carriers across Digital Realty's Los Angeles campus, strengthening connectivity between Asia Pacific and North America. The project is currently in development and is expected to begin supporting cables in 2028.
quarterly_data.figure: new CLS at LAX12 (Los Angeles); expected to begin supporting cables in 2028
